messages.subject: Larkspur — our v2 markup, points to push
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah, Elena,

Going through Calbryn's v1. Points I think we push on the redline:
1. Upfront — try £7m (from £8m) as an opening position.
2. Diligence longstop — 36 months is tight for a pre-clinical asset; push to 42.
3. Liability — the uplift for title/no-conflict warranties is £20m; we should bring it down towards £15m and lengthen the look-back to 36 months.

Will send the tracked v2 tomorrow.

James
